title: Atlantis Guardian
summary: The Atlantis Guardian is an enchantment left by Casterwill Seekers to protect the Casterwill compound located in the center of Atlantis, as well as the Amulet of Will, contained inside the building. He is a self-thinking magical trap that also introduces the tests of bravery, prowess, intelligence and nobility that must be passed to enter the compound.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext: [[Dante Vale]], [[Lok Lambert]], [[Sophie Casterwill]] and [[Zhalia Moon]] encountered the Guardian when trying to enter into the center building of the Atlantis city, in their search for the Amulet of Will. He respectively introduced each member of the team to the tests of bravery, prowess, intelligence and nobility. Upon them passing the tests, he started following Lok's wishes of when to open and close the magical gate to the compound, assisting Lok in his fight against [[Rassimov]]. The Atlantis Guardian also told Lok that he hasn't opened the gate in more than ten thousand years, indicating that [[Eathon Lambert|his dad]] didn't reach that far. Later, he led the team to the lowest chamber of the building, containing the Amulet of Will. He also explained the 500-year war against the [[Nullifiers]] through a painting depicting [[Lord Casterwill]] in the process. {{Source|Coming of Age}}

sections.heading: Personality
sections.wikitext: Despite not being a human, the Atlantis Guardian appears to act exactly like one in many ways. He could sense when Zhalia was feeling uneasy before her test of nobility, and seemed genuinely sorry when he discovered that [[Eathon Lambert|Lok's father]] hadn't made it far enough to pass the gate. He also appeared surprised when Dante passed the test of prowess by tricking the [[Mermen]] into trying to replicate the power of a [[Legendary Titan]]. He generally interacts with those trying to enter the compound in a formal manner, calling Sophie "lady Casterwill" and [[Zhalia Moon]] "young miss". {{Source|Coming of Age}}

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.text: The Atlantis Guardian is not a Seeker, but in actuality a magical trap with the power to open the gate of the Casterwill compound of the city of Atlantis by the click of his fingers, preventing anyone from entering the compound. This gate could send a Titan back to their Amulet if they closed on one, as seen with Anubian. The Guardian appears to follow the orders of whoever passed the tests on whether to open or close the gate. He also had the power to create sentient beings such as Mermen, which he inserted into the Test of Prowess. He possesses deep knowledge in Casterwill history, particularly on the war against the Nullifiers. [Coming of Age]

full_text:
The Atlantis Guardian is an enchantment left by Casterwill Seekers to protect the Casterwill compound located in the center of Atlantis, as well as the Amulet of Will, contained inside the building. He is a self-thinking magical trap that also introduces the tests of bravery, prowess, intelligence and nobility that must be passed to enter the compound.

== History ==
Dante Vale, Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill and Zhalia Moon encountered the Guardian when trying to enter into the center building of the Atlantis city, in their search for the Amulet of Will. He respectively introduced each member of the team to the tests of bravery, prowess, intelligence and nobility. Upon them passing the tests, he started following Lok's wishes of when to open and close the magical gate to the compound, assisting Lok in his fight against Rassimov. The Atlantis Guardian also told Lok that he hasn't opened the gate in more than ten thousand years, indicating that his dad didn't reach that far. Later, he led the team to the lowest chamber of the building, containing the Amulet of Will. He also explained the 500-year war against the Nullifiers through a painting depicting Lord Casterwill in the process. [Coming of Age]

== Personality ==
Despite not being a human, the Atlantis Guardian appears to act exactly like one in many ways. He could sense when Zhalia was feeling uneasy before her test of nobility, and seemed genuinely sorry when he discovered that Lok's father hadn't made it far enough to pass the gate. He also appeared surprised when Dante passed the test of prowess by tricking the Mermen into trying to replicate the power of a Legendary Titan. He generally interacts with those trying to enter the compound in a formal manner, calling Sophie "lady Casterwill" and Zhalia Moon "young miss". [Coming of Age]

== Abilities ==
The Atlantis Guardian is not a Seeker, but in actuality a magical trap with the power to open the gate of the Casterwill compound of the city of Atlantis by the click of his fingers, preventing anyone from entering the compound. This gate could send a Titan back to their Amulet if they closed on one, as seen with Anubian. The Guardian appears to follow the orders of whoever passed the tests on whether to open or close the gate. He also had the power to create sentient beings such as Mermen, which he inserted into the Test of Prowess. He possesses deep knowledge in Casterwill history, particularly on the war against the Nullifiers. [Coming of Age]
